name: Marquee
description: An endless horizontal ticker of short text items, scrolling in a seamless loop with faded edges.
whenToUse: Social proof and momentum strips — client names, press mentions, ticker headlines, value-prop keywords — when the user asks for a marquee, ticker, or endlessly scrolling strip. Pure CSS animation: works without JavaScript and honors prefers-reduced-motion. NOT for logo images (use a LogoCloud-style section) or content the reader must be able to study.
